text:
scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
backup.sh
cleanup.sh
collect.sh
export.sh
fetch.sh
import.sh
lint.sh
pack.sh
prune.sh
report.sh
sync.sh
upload.sh

stderr:

arguments.command: for f in scripts/*.sh; do echo "--- $f"; head -3 "$f"; done

stderr:

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('scripts').glob('*.sh')):
    lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    if lines and lines[0] == '#!/bin/bash' and (len(lines) < 2 or lines[1] != 'set -euo pipefail'):
        lines.insert(1, 'set -euo pipefail')
        p.write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
        print(f'updated {p}')
    else:
        print(f'skipped {p}')
PY
